description: Known-answer vectors for docs/INTEGRITY_SPEC.md. Hex is lowercase. Keys here are TEST KEYS ONLY and must never be used for real signatures.

valid.name: object keys are sorted, nested objects too, array order is kept
insignificant whitespace is removed and integral floats lose their fraction
number forms follow ECMAScript Number-to-String (negative zero becomes 0)
string escapes: short forms, lowercase \u for other control characters, everything else literal
keys sort by UTF-16 code unit, not by code point

invalid.name: integer outside the safe range (2^53 + 1 parses to 2^53)

verification.name: untouched match verifies
events may be supplied in any order
a signature from a retired key still verifies
a changed event payload breaks the chain
two events exchanged between positions break the chain
a removed last event changes the count
a removed middle event leaves a gap in seq
an appended event changes the count
a changed manifest field invalidates the signature
a signature made by another key is rejected
an unknown key id is rejected
a revoked key is rejected
an unsupported spec version is rejected
optional engine and options members are covered by the signature and verify
a changed engine hash invalidates the signature
a removed engine member invalidates the signature
members a verifier does not know are ignored by it but still signed
a manifest that commits to the moves verifies when the moves and their provenance are supplied
the same manifest verifies without the moves (they are then reported as unchecked)
a changed sampling setting in a move's provenance breaks the moves digest
a changed move text breaks the moves digest
an explicit unknown is not the same as a blank: replacing it with null breaks the digest
a removed last move changes the count
a removed middle move leaves a gap in move_index
two moves exchanging their positions break the digest
moves supplied to a manifest that does not commit to them are ignored
a manifest for another match is rejected
